message.content:
**Ambrosia is both**, depending on the source and mythic context. In ancient Greek tradition, it is usually described as the **food of the gods**, while in some texts it is treated as a **drink** or even used interchangeably with nectar.[2][3][6]

A concise way to say it is:

- **Most commonly:** food of the gods[3][5][6]
- **Also attested as:** a drink in some ancient sources and later retellings[2][3][1]

So if you need one simple answer: **food, but not exclusively**.[2][3]
